shots.framing: B-roll: a young man at a pulpit, Bible open, wide shot from the back of the room.
shots.camera: Very slow push-in from the back of the room
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: young man at the pulpit, wide from the back

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: BIBLE PREACHING
graphics.subtitle: YOUNG MEN · JUNIOR & SENIOR HIGH
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: "Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season." Second Timothy four, verse two. Here's how preaching works at SoCal Classic.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.storyboard_caption: Two-shot, P1 quotes Second Timothy four, two

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for preachers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, P1 quotes Second Timothy four, two

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Bible Preaching is for young men in Junior and Senior High. Each school can enter three per division.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, P1 quotes Second Timothy four, two

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Every preacher enters one category. There are three.

graphics.title: 3 SERMON TYPES
graphics.subtitle: EXPOSITORY · EVANGELISTIC · TOPICAL
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Expository. You preach a passage. Your points come straight from it, built around one main idea.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Evangelistic. It's aimed at the lost. The goal is to draw them to Christ.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And Topical. Your main points come from a topic, not from one text.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Junior High preaches six to eight minutes. Senior High, eight to ten.

shots.framing: B-roll: countdown cards 3, 2, 1
shots.camera: Three countdown signs pop up left to right, 3, 2, 1

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Watch the back of the room. You'll see a sign at three minutes left, then two, then one.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Plan to land your conclusion inside your window.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 5: Graphic: countdown cards 3, 2, 1

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: When you get up to preach, hand the judges three typed copies of your outline, plus three judging sheets.

graphics.title: YOUR OUTLINE
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your outline needs a title, a theme and your Scripture references.

graphics.title: YOUR OUTLINE
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Use standard outline form, in full sentences. Include your transitions, and write out your introduction and conclusion.

graphics.title: YOUR OUTLINE
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your judges are experienced preachers and Bible teachers. They use a preaching critique.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And every young man gets a written evaluation after his sermon.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Read it. It's one of the best parts of the day.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Other contestants and visitors are welcome to come listen. So bring your friends.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Pick your type. Write your outline. Watch the signs.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
